caption: The video captures a close-up of a glass jar of transparent liquid, where a central vertical string is already sheathed in a column of white, jagged crystals. Crystallization continues across the central column. The spiky teeth along the column's edges, especially on the right and lower half, grow slightly more pronounced. A thin bed of loose granular crystals on the jar floor remains lightly scattered. A small detached flake to the left stays nearly stationary beside the column, while the surface foam line persists with minor bubble rearrangement. Out-of-focus white fairy lights on twisted wire frame the dark background at left and right.
relations: Supersaturated liquid surrounding the string drives continued crystal deposition along the central column's edges.
Existing jagged teeth on the right and lower half grow slightly more pronounced over time.
The detached flake left of the column stays nearly stationary while adjacent crystals accumulate.
The surface foam line persists with only minor bubble rearrangement as crystallization proceeds.
